notes.title: Patch Note for July 9th
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers!

As promised, the first patch for our debut game demo is live now! Thank you for your patience as we've been working to fix many bugs and implementing as much community feedback as possible.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where the player couldn't switch to the fire rune
[*] Fixed missing actors and breaking quests (dummies, potions, chests, etc.)
[*] Fixed notes respawning after being picked up
[*] Fixed loading trigger range for NPCs
[*] Fixed enemies that spawned before the Smell of Smoke quest
[*] Fixed a bunch of missing or collision related issues, gaps, and z-fighting
[*] Fixed interactable distance for chests and health potions
[*] Fixed tutorial message videos not playing
[*] Fixed tutorial popup disabling option
[/list]

[b]Feedback Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced amount of unnecessary blocking volumes for exploration
[*] Opened up an area of Mossborough that was previously blocked
[*] More chests throughout the world
[*] Blocking volumes no longer block the player camera
[*] Added cross hair when using the runes
[*] Changed demo death screen
[/list]

P.S. We left a "Rocky" surprise...
